items.note: K1.1-K1.4 follow the proof: the net change (JV+RG)x does not depend on the scratch values, the coefficients cancel in both constructions, and the stages compose as (x,y)->(x,y+x)->(-y,y+x)->(-y,x). But K1's headline calls all three stages 'forward invocations', when stage 2 is the inverse schedule (K1.4 has it right). The setting is never given: h=100, banks indexed by triples of [100], N, m, the neighbour rules and the wire counts W_b, W_c.

K2 gives a per-vertex invertible frame shared at each gate, says it commutes with pointwise linear gates, and gives the operator D_out S_Omega D_in^{-1} and the edge changes D_v D_u^{-1}, as at 793-817. It is an infer step resting on the line-812 quote, without the invariant argument, and the signed-route corollary appears only where K4d.3 and K5a.7 use it.

Present: the triple-indicator inner products, the nesting around a side wire, the decreasing-edge claim, L=Ich, the telescoping to Wm-2N+2L, the F_2 orthonormal-basis argument and the ratios 100/539 and 101/539. Missing: the stage spaces A,P,B,Q, the gate-label table eq:motif-labels and the residual table, which are what prove every edge nested and only center 3->4 decreasing (K3.3 just quotes the lemma). The ambient space F^{(x)3} of dimension m and the binary form of the complex network are never stated.

Follows the paper's route: projections as vertex matrices with -P_{U_a} at the X_a sources; rank P_V-P_U = dim V - dim U; the N exceptional source edges 2P_{U_a} of rank one; s_b=W_b m-N+2L_b with deficit N-2L_b>0; and the endpoint difference I_m on every role.

Reconstructs the proof: weight is additive mod 4 on orthogonal vectors, each norm-one basis vector has odd weight, the phase becomes aI+bX_v, the count is s_c=W_c m-2N+2L_c with deficit 2N-2L_c, zero and full labels give C^{(x)m}, and the 27-coordinate X_a->Y_a pair is fixed with C=iZC^{-1}Z. Tensoring over k columns is not spelled out (minor).

The chain matches 1105-1110 and 1319-1346: L/N<1/2, the deficits N-2L_b and 2N-2L_c, both eta above 20*2^-50, log m<20, so s/W<m^tau with tau=sigma=1-2^-50. But eta is never defined as (Wm-s)/(Wm), and its exact values 339/22587335000000 and 73/19906842167500 are not given.

R2a lists the elementary O(V) operations loosely (digit moves, split/merge, row splits). R2b's claim leaves out conditions: that the offset be preparable in b^{O(1)} time (it appears only in the quote), the prime radix q, and the rational coefficients with denominators prime to q. Neither step has a derivation.

K4c follows 1425-1447: O(V) triangular updates in descending order, the E_1 Pi E_2 sequence, and one interchange per pivot through D_j+=H_i, swap, D_j=H_i-D_j, giving exactly a interchanges. But the factorization K4b is only stated (the elimination proof at 1375-1392 is not reconstructed), and the choice of a fixed odd prime q avoiding all denominators (1413-1423) is missing.

Follows the proof: the cyclic row split into W streams of volume V/W, each edge Phi_{A_e} done by recursive interchanges, the frame identity giving Phi_{I_m} on every role, the three updates turning the shear into an interchange, s calls, F_k<=(s/W)F_{k-1}+O(1) with the geometric sum, and the O(V) depth-first schedule.

Covers the high-digit row field R=q^{2rho}>=W^k, padding to R'<2R, the base-m pieces costing O(V) sum a_j m^{j tau}=O(Ve^tau), the radix padding of binary chunks, and the case of widths differing by one bit, all as in the paper.

Gives the slot layout with one child (C^{eps})^{(x)f} per residual direction, the inverse-child identity, at most m(m-1)+3m row additions, exactly s_c children on e/m axes, and H_0^{(x)D}=b^D S_D C^{(x)D} S_D. The conjugation P_M X_v P_M^{-1}=X_{Mv} appears only in K5i's method.

Follows the proof: the eight packed additions and their parity cycles, the guard interval and bad set B with delta_bad=min{1,80(f-1)2^-K}, T_0 S_0^{-1} permuting B, swap and rotation costs, and the radix-sort repair. The separate two-bit XOR at j_{f-1} is not mentioned (minor).

Reproduces the node overhead O(V((eK)^tau+1)), q_0 rows with padding to multiples of W^{k_0}, children of volume V/W, F(e)<=(s/W)F(e/m)+O((eK)^tau+1), the overhead and leaf bounds, the base-m pieces, and O(d^{lambda'}) for max{lambda, sigma+beta(1-sigma)}<lambda'<1.

States the layer returning Q_p(Hz) in O(Vd^{lambda'}) with error <sqrt2 2^-p, and derives the guard width: A(e)<=sA(e/m)+E, depth <=8B^2 d^{nu+1}, total <128mB^2 d^{nu+3}<=C_0 d^{C_1}, Delta=o(p) since epsilon C_1<1. It also has the disk-preservation argument.

Follows the paper: character cancellation via y^{rj_0}=-1, decimation in frequency with bit-reversed storage B_t, the reversed procedure giving F^+B^{-1}, parallel rounds, the layout L by prefix moves and chunk exchanges, a single truncation per round, the error bound and the cost.

Evaluation at B_0=2^{4p}, the separation bound |h_j|<B_0/2, two's-complement packing with carries in {-1,0}, centered extraction with carries in {0,1}, the negacyclic reduction, truncation, and four products dominating the cost, as in the proof.

Gives the normalization via the convolution theorem, P(LBu,LBv)=LB P(u,v) so the retained order is used, the error chain 2delta+eta -> 3delta+eta -> M(3delta+eta), and M=T/r products costing O(Tp log(rp)).

Follows the paper: the cited Gaussian identity and ||N-I||<2^{-alpha^2 theta}, Neumann invertibility, contractions A=S/2 and B_0=D'J'C with normalizations multiplying to 2^{-2alpha^2}, the numerical errors 16p, 3p^2/4 and 4, the permutations kept in the identity, then tensoring, linewise application on the padded box, and the O(Tp d^2(1+ell^tau)) axis exposure.

Chirp periodicity, the coefficient computation identifying QF_t, the dilation identity F^+R_c=R_c^{-1}F^+, the commutation of R with pointwise products, the two normalizations giving (u*v)/S^2, and the conjugation trick, matching 3938-3988.

Correctly given: the sizes b,p,d,K,T,r,t_i, eq:sizes, the prime-interval lemma with eta=1/(4d), T/2<S<T, alpha^4 theta>p, the n^{o(1)} prime search, no wraparound, and c_j<2^{3b}. Missing: the fixed rational exponents of eq:fixed-parameters (lambda, c, lambda', epsilon, delta), the layer-condition checks at 4018-4036, the comparison constants, and the gamma bound eq:gamma (gamma<=b/4), which F5.9 uses without derivation.

The algebra isomorphism via the order-S image of x, the triangular formula b_i, updates in order d..1, the identity on invalid controls preserving the padding, and the O(Tp d^2(1+ell^tau)) cost, as in the paper.

The exact twist is derived faithfully: well-definedness, diagonal isomorphism, the wrap check zeta^{k+l}(-1)^h=zeta^j, and M_C=(f*g)/T. The computed version (approximate phases, the f',g',h' sequence with truncations, twist errors below 4*2^-p each) appears only as the numbers in F5.2, without derivation.

Gives the source transform 2^gamma B_0 Q F_t A = R F_s and the six-step algorithm (digits scaled by 2^{-b-2}, Phi, two forward transforms, pointwise product, opposite transform, scales S and 2^{2b+4}S, rounding, Phi^{-1}, carries), with the reason both scales by S are needed.

Reproduces the error chain E_ring<5TL, 6TL, 8TL, E_s=9*2^gamma TL, 2E_s+2, 3E_s+2, E_w<28*2^gamma T^2 L, the final bound 448b 2^{-3b/4}<1/2, rounding, the carry bounds and the invariant, and the 2n-bit output. The gamma<=b/4 bound is used but comes from eq:gamma, which is not derived.

Gives the seven table rows with their powers of p, the margins g_1..g_7 with min g_i=2^-181=2kappa, the justification of the rows, o(Tp) setup and exceptional sorting, and the final O(Tp p^{1-kappa})=O(n(log n)^{1-kappa}) with schoolbook multiplication below a cutoff.

S0 says the bound refutes the n log n optimality conjecture. It gives none of the content: the eventual lower-bound formulation T_A(n)>=c_A n lg n, its negation via liminf T_A(n)/(n lg n)=0, or the scoping to the fixed-tape model.

errors.says: Three forward invocations of the network send (X_a,Y_a)->(-Y_a,X_a).
errors.paper: The three stages are a forward invocation X->Y at stage 1, the inverse forward schedule Y->X at stage 2 (which effects X<-X-Y), and a forward invocation at stage 3. K1.4 states this correctly.

errors.says: For a Boolean control c the eight operations induce the cycles (00 01 10) and (01 10 11).
errors.paper: The operations do nothing when c=0; the cycles are induced only when c=1.

chain: The tree reaches O(n(lg n)^{1-kappa}) by the paper's route. Radix digits go through the CRT map, Gaussian resampling with the permutations kept in the identity, chirp convolution, the coefficient twist, and synthetic convolution, whose transforms use the two power-saving tape procedures; exact recovery and the cost table follow. It thins at the base of the central saving and at the parameters. The fixed network's setting (h=100, triple-indexed banks, N, m, the wire counts) is never stated. The label assignment behind Wm-2N+2L is quoted rather than reconstructed. Most fixed rational exponents and the gamma<=b/4 bound are used without being given.

steps.note: The bank-exchange network is reconstructed in detail: net change independent of the scratch values, coefficient cancellation, three stages giving (X_a,Y_a)->(-Y_a,X_a), every auxiliary wire restored. But h=100, the indexing of X_a,Y_a by triples, N=binom(h,3)^3 and m=h^3 never appear. Since these are listed defining content, the verdict is the conservative one.

K2 states that a common invertible frame per gate commutes with pointwise gates, so the network implements D_out S D_in^{-1} and each edge costs only the change D_v D_u^{-1}. K4d.3 applies it to get Phi_{I_m} on every role.

Nondegenerate labels from tensor products of triple lines, comparable labels on every edge, and the only decreasing edges being center 3->4, each losing h, are all stated. The ambient space F^{(x)3} and its dimension m are only alluded to.
rank(P_V-P_U)=dim V-dim U for nested labels, with the N source edges 2P_{U_a} of rank one as the exceptions, matching 1158-1165.
L=Ich and sum |Delta dim|=Wm-2N+2L by telescoping, and s_b=W_b m-N+2L_b.
L_b/N=100/539 and L_c/N=101/539, both below 1/2, so the deficits N-2L_b and 2N-2L_c are positive and s<Wm.
M_sink(rho(w))-M_source(w)=I_m on every role (P_{U_a^perp}+P_{U_a} on X_a, 0 to I elsewhere), so the bit network applies H<-H+D on every role, scratch rows included.
A=E_1 Pi E_2, the shear costs exactly a interchanges plus O(V), each edge is done by recursive interchanges, and there are exactly s recursive calls per node.
Children of volume V/W, F_k<=(s/W)F_{k-1}+O(1), and s/W<m^tau with tau=1-2^-50, from eta>20*2^-50 and log m<20, give F_k=O(e^tau). The exact eta values are not given, but the comparison is.

central.summary: The plan reconstructs the central saving almost completely. It has frames, nested labels, rank equal to dimension change with the N source exceptions, the budget Wm-2N+2L and s_b=W_b m-N+2L_b, the ratios 100/539 and 101/539, the endpoint identity, edges as rank-many recursive calls, and the recurrence with tau=1-2^-50. Its weak point is the start: the bank-exchange network is derived, but the fixed setting (h=100, triple-indexed banks, N, m) that gives these numbers is never stated. So eight of nine steps are reconstructed and C1 is only mentioned.
